title: Select Map Object Type (Robot/Container/Cell/Charger) Before Clicking on the Map
summary: In the RMS / fleet status UI Map Monitor, multiple object types are clickable. Select the correct Quick Select object selection mode (Robot/Container/Cell/Charger) on the left panel before clicking a map item so you inspect the intended object type.
when_to_use: Use when you need to inspect a specific object type on the RMS Map Monitor map (robot vs container vs cell vs charger) and you want the map click to target the correct type.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the Map Monitor Quick Select mode selection and map click inspection workflow.
access_or_tools_needed: RMS / fleet status UI (Map Monitor) Quick Select panel

system_preconditions: Map Monitor is available and shows the map with clickable items and the left-side Quick Select icons.

visual_references.description: Map Monitor Quick Select left-side icons showing object selection modes (Robot Selection, Cell Selection, Charger Selection; container icon if present).

steps.title: Open RMS Map Monitor and locate Quick Select object selection icons
steps.purpose: Establish the correct selection mode controls before clicking any map item.
steps.instruction: Open the RMS / fleet status UI (Map Monitor). On the left panel, locate the Quick Select object selection icons for Robot, Container (if present), Cell, and Charger.
steps.expected_result: The left-side Quick Select icons for object selection modes are visible (Robot Selection, Cell Selection, Charger Selection; container selection icon if present).
steps.healthy_condition: You can clearly see the object selection icons on the left panel before interacting with the map.
steps.failure_condition: You click a map item without first selecting the intended object type mode, or the required selection icons are not visible.

actions.label: Locate Quick Select icons
actions.exact_action: Locate the left-side Quick Select object selection icons: “Robot Selection”, “Cell Selection”, “Charger Selection” (and the container selection icon if present).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Certain things in the map are clickable; however, because there are multiple type of objects on the map, you need to select what object you want to inspect right. On the left side panel you have icons: robot, container, cell, charger. Before you proceed and click something on the map itself, you'll have to choose what you want to select.

steps.title: Choose the object type you want to inspect
steps.purpose: Ensure the subsequent map click targets the correct object type.
steps.instruction: Decide whether you want to inspect a robot, container, cell, or charger.
steps.expected_result: You have selected the intended object type to inspect (robot vs container vs cell vs charger).
steps.healthy_condition: The chosen object type matches what you intend to investigate on the map.
steps.failure_condition: You intend to inspect one object type but plan to click without selecting that corresponding mode.

actions.label: Select intended object type
actions.exact_action: Decide which object you want to inspect (robot vs container vs cell vs charger).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Because there are multiple type of objects on the map, you need to select what object you want to inspect right... So before you proceed and click something on the map itself, you'll have to choose what you want to select.

steps.title: Select the corresponding Quick Select icon for the chosen object type
steps.purpose: Set the map inspection mode so clicks become inspectable for the intended object type.
steps.instruction: On the left panel, click the Quick Select icon that matches your chosen object type (e.g., click “Robot Selection” to inspect robots).
steps.expected_result: The Quick Select mode corresponding to the chosen object type is selected (e.g., Robot Selection for robots).
steps.healthy_condition: The selected mode corresponds to the object type you intend to click on the map.
steps.failure_condition: A different object type mode remains selected than the one you intend to inspect.

actions.label: Click object selection icon
actions.exact_action: Click the corresponding selection icon on the left panel (e.g., click “Robot Selection” to inspect robots).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: So on the panel, on this panel on the left side, you have couple of icons. The first one is robot, the second one is container, the third one is cell and the fourth one is charger. So before you proceed and click something on the map itself, you'll have to choose what you want to select. So if you wanna select... inspect the robot, you gotta click the robot and so on and so forth.

steps.title: Click the target object on the map
steps.purpose: Perform the inspection click using the selected object type mode.
steps.instruction: Click the target object on the map.
steps.expected_result: The clicked map item is inspected as the selected object type (robot/container/cell/charger).
steps.healthy_condition: The inspection result corresponds to the selected type (i.e., you are not inspecting a different object type than intended).
steps.failure_condition: The clicked object does not inspect as the selected type (wrong object type is inspected).

actions.label: Click map item
actions.exact_action: Click the target object on the map.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the wrong object type is inspected after selecting a mode, stop and re-select the correct object type icon before proceeding.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Certain things in the map are clickable... because there are multiple type of objects on the map, you need to select what object you want to inspect right... before you proceed and click something on the map itself, you'll have to choose what you want to select.

steps.title: Verify the click inspects the intended object type; re-select mode if not
steps.purpose: Confirm the inspection mode worked and correct it immediately if it did not.
steps.instruction: Verify that the clicked object responds as the selected type (robot vs container vs cell vs charger). If it does not, stop and re-select the correct object type icon before clicking again.
steps.expected_result: You confirm the clicked object is inspected as the intended object type; otherwise you re-select the correct mode and repeat the click.
steps.healthy_condition: The inspection behavior matches the selected Quick Select object type mode.
steps.failure_condition: The inspection behavior indicates a different object type than the selected mode.

actions.label: Verify inspected type
actions.exact_action: Verify that the clicked object responds as the selected type (i.e., you are inspecting the intended object type rather than a different map object).

actions.label: Re-select correct mode
actions.exact_action: If clicking does not inspect the intended object type, stop and re-select the correct object type icon before clicking again.

stop_or_escalate_if: Wrong object type inspected after selecting a mode → stop and re-select the correct object type icon before proceeding.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Because there are multiple type of objects on the map, you need to select what object you want to inspect right... before you proceed and click something on the map itself, you'll have to choose what you want to select.

success_criteria: After selecting the correct Quick Select object selection icon, clicking a map item inspects that chosen object type (robot/container/cell/charger).
healthy_conditions: Quick Select object selection icons are visible on the left panel in Map Monitor.
A map click results in inspection of the intended object type matching the selected mode.
failure_conditions: A map click inspects a different object type than the selected Quick Select mode.
User proceeds to click without selecting the intended object type icon first.
escalation_guidance: If you cannot get the map click to inspect the intended object type even after re-selecting the correct Quick Select icon, stop and escalate to the appropriate support team/site process (no further escalation steps are specified in the provided source).
